item.title: Drop in Gulf remittances puts families on edge
item.description: Pakistanis in the Gulf send money to support families with basic needs like food and education. For millions of households, money sent by Pakistani workers in the Gulf offers a lifeline, helping their families cover basic needs such as food and education.

item.title: US hopes for ‘serious offer’ from Iran today on latest proposal, despite exchange of strikes
item.description: US President Trump confirmed a ceasefire with Iran remains in place following an exchange of fire between the two countries. The situation escalated tensions, but Trump maintained that the ceasefire agreement holds.

item.title: Al Jazeera reporter witnesses Israeli strikes on Lebanon
item.description: Al Jazeera's Obaida Hitto reports Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon from Tyre. Israel has increased its attacks across southern Lebanon. Al Jazeera’s Obaida Hitto reports from Tyre. Al Jazeera reporter witnesses Israeli strikes on Lebanon.

item.title: Trump says Russia and Ukraine to observe three-day ceasefire
item.description: Donald Trump announced a three-day ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine. It comes as the two countries accused each other of violating separate ceasefires to cover the celebrations of the Soviet Union's victory over Nazi Germany.

item.description: US President Trump announced a three-day ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine, set to start immediately. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the ceasefire "must be established". Volodymyr Zelensky, however, said the ceasefire "must be established".

item.title: Rubio questions allies' support on Iran following Italy talks
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio urged European allies like Italy to support US efforts against Iran. Rubio expressed puzzlement at any lack of support. “I don't understand why anybody would not be supportive,” said US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, urging European allies like Italy to back US efforts against Iran.

item.title: Trump announces three-day ceasefire in Russia-Ukraine war
item.description: US President Trump announced a three-day ceasefire in the Russia-Ukraine war, including a swap of 1,000 prisoners of war from each country. Truce will also include swap of 1,000 prisoners of war from each country, US president says.

item.title: ASEAN leaders adopt measures to ease economic pain caused by Iran war
item.description: ASEAN leaders have adopted measures to ease economic pain caused by the Iran war. The bloc imports over half its crude oil from the Middle East, making it vulnerable to price shocks.

item.title: Three hikers 'creating online content' killed on active volcano after 'ignoring safety warnings'
item.description: Three hikers were killed on an active volcano after ignoring safety warnings. They were attempting to create online content, despite clear warnings against the ascent. A volcanic eruption has killed three hikers "driven by the desire to create online content" after they defied safety warnings and attempted an ascent.

item.title: Greece examines mystery naval drone found in Ionian Sea
item.description: Greece is examining a mystery naval drone found in the Ionian Sea. The drone reportedly had explosives and could be linked to the Russia-Ukraine war or be of Ukrainian origin.

item.title: Before Hantavirus Outbreak, the MV Hondius Attracted ‘a Different Type of Traveler’
item.description: The MV Hondius attracted a different type of traveler before the Hantavirus outbreak. Former passengers say the ship prioritized safety and was designed for wildlife expeditions. Former passengers on the MV Hondius say that the ship was made for wildlife expeditions and that the crew took safety very seriously.

item.title: Frustrated by Iran, Trump at last seizes enriched uranium – but from Venezuela
item.description: The US has removed 13.5kg of uranium from a reactor in Caracas, Venezuela. This is a fraction of the 408kg held by Iran, and the move is seen as a response to Iran's nuclear activities.

item.title: US employers defy economic shock from Iran war, add a surprisingly strong 115,000 jobs
item.description: The United States added 115,000 jobs in April, beating expectations, with the unemployment rate steady at 4.3 per cent. US employers defy economic shock from Iran war, add a surprisingly strong 115,000 jobs.
